name: Ruido de Video
description: Analiza patrones de ruido de video para detectar manipulación
algorithm: Video Noise Consistency — Statistical Pattern Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes video noise consistency for forensic detection:

1. **Ruido Estimación**: Per-region noise level and noise characteristics are estimated from each frame using smooth-region analysis and noise estimation algorithms. The noise model (Gaussian, Poisson, mixed) and parameters (variance, spatial correlation) are determined.

2. **Ruido Espacial Consistencia**: Camera noise should be spatially consistent — same sensor, same noise for all regions at a given signal level. The method compares noise characteristics between face and background. Deepfake composites show noise mismatches — the generated face has different noise (from the generator) than the captured background (from the camera sensor).

3. **Ruido - Señal Relationship**: Camera noise follows specific noise-signal relationships: photon shot noise creates variance proportional to signal. The method checks this relationship across the frame. AI-generated content may show incorrect noise-signal dependencies — either constant noise (additive model) or noise patterns that don't follow physical sensor models.

4. **Ruido Espectral Shape**: Camera sensor noise has specific spatial frequency characteristics determined by the anti-aliasing filter and readout electronics. The method analyzes noise power spectral density — AI generators produce noise with different spectral characteristics than camera sensors.

5. **Temporal Ruido Análisis**: Frame-to-frame noise should be independently distributed (uncorrelated). The method checks temporal noise independence — AI-generated frames may show correlated noise patterns (repeated noise structures between frames or systematically evolving noise) inconsistent with camera capture.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: estadística
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante video noise consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
